# ANSH&CO — Brand Custodians, AI Solutions & Full-Stack Digital Engineering Studio

> ANSH&CO is an independent Brand Custodianship, High-Speed Next.js Web Engineering, AI Workflow Automation, Custom CRM/ERP, and Viral Performance Marketing Studio headquartered in Aman Vihar, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India, serving ambitious startups and enterprise brands globally.

## 15 In-House Services & Capabilities
1. **Web Development**: High-speed bespoke React & Next.js platforms, headless e-commerce, and Core Web Vitals optimization (99+ PageSpeed scores).
2. **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform iOS & Android apps (React Native / Flutter).
3. **Custom CRM**: Bespoke sales pipeline automation, WhatsApp/website lead capture, and third-party API integrations.
4. **ERP Systems**: Scalable Enterprise Resource Planning for inventory, finance, and operational BI.
5. **AI Solutions & Workflow Automation**: Trigger-based AI architectures, multi-agent systems, and automated lead qualification saving 40+ hours/week.
6. **Digital Marketing**: Full-funnel omnichannel growth frameworks and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
7. **Technical & Organic SEO**: Search engine domination, topical authority, schema architecture, and AEO/GEO optimization.
8. **Meta Ads & Google Ads**: High-ROAS paid acquisition, dynamic product ads, and creative split-testing matrices.
9. **Content Creation**: Brand storytelling, high-converting copywriting, and visual asset libraries.
10. **Social Media Management**: Content calendar strategy, active community curation, and platform-specific visual feeds.
11. **Social Media & Viral Meme Marketing**: Pop-culture moment marketing, Hinglish & global viral hooks, and creator alliances.
12. **AI Video Generation**: Synthetic media workflows, dynamic ad variations, and AI script-to-screen pipelines.
13. **Graphic Designing & Brand Identity**: Bespoke wordmarks, luxury tactile packaging, 3D mockups, and spatial branding.
14. **Content Marketing**: Thought leadership whitepapers, SEO pillar articles, and retention email drips.
15. **Cinematic Video Editing & Public Relations**: High-retention Instagram Reels/YouTube Shorts, commercial films, sound design, and executive PR placements.
